result.rationale: The diff adds `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)` in the Salesforce CalendarService refresh flow. Relying on the reason phrase is fragile: HTTP/2 responses (and some proxies) carry an empty statusText, so a successful 200 response would be rejected with a 400. Checking `response.ok` (or `response.status === 200`) is the correct gate. This is a real defect in newly added code.
